text: Lesson 15 found it: an Oracle table with unprotected customer SSNs Purview has never seen. This lesson closes the gap -- the data, and the process behind it.
Registration only reached the reporting view, never the table beneath it. That same scan already flagged this as lighter than expected -- the review item was simply never closed out.
The fix: register the real table alongside the view, scan it, let the classifier confirm the match, label it Confidential-PII, and revoke the broad legacy grant.
The bigger fix is a recurring check comparing each source's real schema catalog against what Purview registered -- built to catch a table hiding behind a view, automatically, every month.
Both SSN columns are now labeled and controlled. Next: putting this whole program in front of leadership.
